_meta.purpose: Worker A consolidation decision overlay; preserves immutable batch research and master queue
_meta.important_limit: Narrow review list is a rule-based, manually curated triage from research flags, not a proof that other entries have perfect coordinates. Individual source site verification remains incomplete.
_meta.revision: Simplified active status to TWO categories only: 252 location identified, 39 location details need checking, 291 active. Closed records excluded from active index, not shown as a category. Historical research and reasons remain preserved.
_meta.review_note: 27 name/alias/possible duplicate comparison cases analyzed; source URLs and descriptions compared. Existing 21 duplicate flags were NOT 21 verified duplicates. No speculative merge is authorized. User need not adjudicate routine alias matching.
_meta.source_technical_note: 21 source/link-warning flags now explained as 4 HTTP451, 10 cache misses, 3 source page unavailable, 4 archive URL/name mismatches; earlier 20 heuristic not a count of broken links.
_meta.last_cross_reference_result: 39 of 39 unclear candidates examined against publicly accessible original URLs, archived source alignment and independent geographical references; no exact-site identity confirmed, so all 39 retained for precise-location research. New clues saved for Linkeroever, Keflavik, Vilnius, and Prijedor.
_meta.full_verification_note: First 100 original identified locations reviewed; 23 reclassified needing exact location; 152 original identified remain for same pass.
_meta.full_verification_coverage_limit: All 252 original research records evaluated against available eight-site archival alignment and targeted fresh web searching; this is not full authenticated fresh querying of 8 websites per individual source. Records preserve evidence and uncertainty.

decision_policy.recency: Do not require a confirmed physical sexual encounter. Keep separate recent discussions, dated questions, self check-ins, firsthand accounts, older listings and negative reports; no negative conclusion from absent data.
decision_policy.public_shared_spaces: Informational context only; not a categorical disqualification.
decision_policy.general_access_and_safety: Informational context only unless an explicit current closure makes normal public entry unavailable.
decision_policy.old_information: Combine with recency/conflict review, rather than treating age alone as a separate blocker.
decision_policy.technical_source_pages: Retain source links and inaccessible/blocked statuses; lack of access is not proof of no location.
decision_policy.duplicate_policy: Compare original source record IDs, URLs, spot/subarea descriptions and coordinates. Keep potentially distinct cruising spots in same park/retail building separated, never merge based solely on location name; investigation should be automated/researched, not delegated to user.
